name: orders_by_status
description: List orders with a given status, newest first.
sql: SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer, o.status, o.total_paise / 100.0 AS total_inr, o.placed_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = :status ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC

name: revenue_by_city
description: Paid and shipped revenue per customer city between two dates (inclusive).
sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.total_paise) / 100.0 AS revenue_inr FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped') AND o.placed_at BETWEEN :from AND :to GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY revenue_inr DESC

name: customer_orders
description: Orders for one customer, looked up by email.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.status, o.total_paise / 100.0 AS total_inr, o.placed_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.email = :email ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC

name: top_customers
description: Customers ranked by lifetime paid/shipped spend.
sql: SELECT c.name, c.city, SUM(o.total_paise) / 100.0 AS spend_inr FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY spend_inr DESC LIMIT :limit

name: add_support_note
description: Attach a support note to an order.
sql: INSERT INTO support_notes (order_id, note, created_at) VALUES (:order_id, :note, date('now'))
